description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Top Secret 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description 
 
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. 
 
 
 Come join  Northrop  Grumman   –  Xetron , part of the  Mission  Systems  sector, where we develop new capabilities for our military and intelligence customers around the globe. At Xetron we design systems that only science fiction writers could imagine, because they’re that cool!
 
 Xetron  is an operating unit of the Northrop Grumman Corporation, located in  Cincinnati, Ohio  where employees have the chance to know everyone on site while working on cutting‑edge technologies and high‑impact products. You’ll tackle the next generation of challenging problems, share expertise, and learn from world‑class teammates. Remember when you were excited about the challenge of the problem, the importance of the solution, and the fun you had with your team? You’ll experience that at Xetron! See why we receive comments on our  YouTube Videos  like “This company is insanely advanced” and “Wow. This is mind blowing.” 
 
 We are seeking  cleared Software Engineers  who are self‑motivated and energetic, with a background in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical disciplines.
 
 Responsibilities: 
 This position is for a  Software Engineer  position to work within a team of software engineers implementing  cloud-based, full-stack software applications  that incorporate advanced algorithms, decision support processing, and data fusion. The Software Engineer serves on a team that creates, evolves, and maintains the architecture of the software to meet operational needs across the full stack (front-end, back-end, data, and cloud infrastructure).
 
 The  cloud-native solution  will include:
 Decision support system processing and orchestration
 Algorithm development and integration (e.g., optimization, analytics, and automated reasoning)
 Producing knowledge from  disparate data sources  and sensors via scalable data services and APIs
 Implementation of user-facing components and services that expose these capabilities to operators and analytic users
 
 The position requires strong  full-stack software engineering  skills and solid understanding of modern cloud architectures. Desired knowledge includes computer networking and optimization, modern software development environments, cloud integration, and virtualized/containerized computing environments such as Docker or VMware. Experience developing solutions using SysML/UML is a plus.
 
 What You’ll Get to Do 
 Be part of a team building  cloud-based, full-stack mission applications  that directly impact national security
 Own the  architecture and design  of advanced decision support systems and analytic services
 Build and integrate  microservices, APIs, and data pipelines  that turn disparate data into actionable insight
 Develop web-based user interfaces that integrate with backend processes and databases
 Work with modern tech (cloud services, containers, CI/CD) in a  real-world, operational environment 
 
 Essential Functions: 
 Full-stack Software Engineering , to include design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and operations of cloud-based mission applications and services
 Design and implementation of  cloud-hosted microservices, APIs, and data pipelines  to support decision support and analytic workflows
 Evaluation of commercial solutions as part of make/buy analyses, including cloud services and COTS/GOTS components
 Development of custom algorithms and analytic services for decision making and situational awareness
 Integration of custom analytic tools and decision support capabilities into an overall system and enterprise architecture
 Development of  data products and knowledge services  for automated and manual consumers of generated data (dashboards, UIs, external systems, and APIs)
 
 Basic Qualifications for Sr. Principal Cyber Software Engineer Level :
 
 B.S. degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field and 2 years of programming experience; or M.S. degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field and ? years of programming experience or Ph.D and ? years of relevant work experience.
 Demonstrated experience developing software solutions using Python, C, or C++
 Demonstrated experience integrating commercial software products as part of a custom software solution
 Proven experience with the full lifecycle of software engineering including the operations and maintenance of fielded systems
 Active Top-Secret clearance is required
 US Citizenship is required
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Active SCI security clearance
 Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
 Experience developing software solutions for US government classified environments
 Hands-on experience developing full-stack software solutions hosted in cloud environments such as AWS or Azure (e.g., microservices, serverless, containerized workloads, managed data services)
 Experience with web development including Typescript, Javascript, React and Go
 Experience integrating COTS/GOTS software tools into a deliverable software product
 Experience with Agile methodology
 Experience with software development utilizing UML or SysML within Cameo
 Familiarity with modern source control platforms (e.g., Git, GitHub, GitLab) and CI/CD workflows using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI.
 
 This position offers the option of a 9/80 work schedule. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.
 
 
 
 
Primary Level Salary Range: $91,800.00 - $137,600.00 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions. 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business. 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. 
 
Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.
